articles.title: Why Trump's bitcoin ETF plans likely collapsed before getting off the ground
articles.snippet: Trump Media withdrew its bitcoin ETF filing as analysts pointed to fee pressure, weak demand and fierce competition in the crowded spot bitcoin ETF market.

articles.title: Telegram group at center of Jane Street insider-trading allegations in Terra collapse
articles.snippet: Newly unsealed filings detail a private chat dubbed ‘Bryce’s Secret’ that Terraform’s estate says gave Jane Street an informational edge before UST’s collapse.

articles.title: Fairshake PAC’s $20M backing pays off in three US state primaries
articles.snippet: Five Republicans and one Democrat won or went to runoffs following primaries in Georgia, Alabama and Kentucky after a crypto-backed PAC and its affiliates spent a combined $20 million on media and ads.

articles.title: GitHub investigates unauthorized access to internal repositories
articles.snippet: GitHub said the activity involved the exfiltration of about 3,800 internal repositories, and it removed the malicious code extension.
